description: This file defines the ProfileReader class which implements logic to read user profile information, fetches data from a database context, performs checks, and maps data to a Profile object within the Profiles feature of the Conduit application.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: A class responsible for retrieving user profile data based on username, including checking follow status and mapping data to profile envelope.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a user profile based on username, with optional follow status checking, and returns a profile envelope.
